notes.title: Tiny Teams Festival & Online Demo Out NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hello friends,

Being a part of the Tiny Teams Festival for the second time is a big honor, so we decided that this year we needed to do something SPECIAL! We have an online demo up right now that you can download and play the game with us. We've included the core elements in Pixel Skater, such as Trick Attack, Graffiti, and King of the Hill. You can make your own skaters and also edit levels and save them which both (should) work with the final release (maybe).

We are trying our best to get as many people actively playing so we can not only hang out with our cool community, but also squash any bugs that might come up (we are a team of 2, so testing with multiple people is very hard! We've never even had a full room!)

If you're interested in joining us or just want to host your own room, go for it. We just wanna see people playing, exploring, and creating! The demo is only live until the 14th of August, so don't miss out!

(or you could totally join our discord where we're going to be doing more online events / betas, but no pressure)

https://discord.gg/GtEh8eY
click it, you know you wanna ;)

notes.title: Tiny Teams Festival!
notes.notes:
Hey guys, exciting news!

We have been invited to be a part of the Yogscast Tiny Teams Festival and will be listed on their event page. Check out the link below to see the amazing sale they're having on other indie darlings, as well as a chance to see the Pixel Skater demo streamed to the world! There might be a surprise coming later this week, so make sure to check back soon.  ;)

https://bit.ly/TinyTeams20

Thanks to the Yogscast team for putting a spotlight on our little bundle of stress and joy!
